feat(camellia): add shadcn style preset baseline

Summary:
- add a persisted `shadcn-ui` style preset alongside theme mode
- move dashboard and playground onto the new preset-driven shell
- normalize AI, Scene, and Square list pages to shared Card + Table surfaces

Rationale:
- the issue scope was corrected to require a concrete visual style rather than
  only removing custom styling
- centralizing tokens and shared surfaces keeps future style presets feasible
  without rewriting every route
